from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import cohen_kappa_score
import re

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv('/app/train.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/app/test.csv')

# Basic text features
def extract_features(text):
    words = text.split()
    sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]+', text)
    sentences = [s for s in sentences if s.strip()]
    return {
        'word_count': len(words),
        'sentence_count': max(len(sentences), 1),
        'avg_word_length': np.mean([len(w) for w in words]) if words else 0,
        'avg_sentence_length': len(words) / max(len(sentences), 1),
        'unique_word_ratio': len(set(w.lower() for w in words)) / max(len(words), 1),
        'char_count': len(text),
        'paragraph_count': max(text.count('\n\n') + 1, 1),
    }

print("Extracting features for train...")
train_feats = pd.DataFrame([extract_features(t) for t in train['full_text']])
print("Extracting features for test...")
test_feats = pd.DataFrame([extract_features(t) for t in test['full_text']])

print("Building TF-IDF features...")

    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    strip_accents='unicode',
)

)

X_test_char = tfidf_char.transform(test['full_text'])

X_test = hstack([X_test_tfidf, X_test_char, test_feats.values])
y_train = train['score'].values

# Train Gradient Boosting Regressor

    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    random_state=42,
)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict and clip to valid range

preds = model.predict(X_train)
